title: ISO Week Number Calculator
h1: ISO Week Number Calculator — Week of the Year
seoTitle: ISO Week Number Calculator — Week of Year
description: Find the ISO 8601 week number for any date, plus the week-year and the Monday that starts that week. Useful for schedules and reports. Local only.
intro: Pick a date to see its ISO week number. Weeks start on Monday, and week 1 is the week that contains the first Thursday of the calendar year.
blurb: Look up the ISO week number, week-year and Monday start for any date.
howItWorks: Choose a calendar date. The default is 5 October 2026.
Press Get week number. The result uses the ISO rule that weeks start on Monday.
Week 1 is the week with the year's first Thursday, so early January can belong to the previous week-year.
examples: 1 January 2021 was a Friday in ISO week 53 of 2020.
4 January 2021 was a Monday and the start of ISO week 1 of 2021.
5 October 2026 falls in an ISO week that starts on the previous Monday.

faq.q: Why can January belong to the previous year?
faq.a: ISO week-years follow Thursday. If 1 January falls on Friday, Saturday or Sunday, those days are in week 52 or 53 of the previous week-year.
Monday. Sunday is the last day of an ISO week, not the first.
The date you pick is treated as a calendar date, not a timestamp, so timezone offsets do not shift the week.
